name: WEDM Integration Wiring — Frontend↔Backend Shape Bridge
description: Bridge the data shape mismatch between WEDM frontend API types (wedmStudio.ts) and backend engine input/output shapes. The edmDispatcher passes params straight through without transformation. E2E test (wedm-e2e-pipeline.test.ts) shows 8/17 stages fail due to: (1) frontend sends flat params but engines expect nested objects, (2) engines return nested results but frontend expects flat shapes, (3) missing default fields engines require.

units.name: Shape audit — map all 20 WEDM actions input/output contracts
units.description: Read every WEDM engine interface (FeasibilityInput, FullSelectionInput, ToolpathInput, MultiPassInput, CuttingParamInput, EDMGCodeInput, CostInput, SetupSheetInput, StartHolePlan params, wire break params). Document the exact mismatch between what the frontend sends vs what the engine expects. Create a WEDM_SHAPE_MAP.md reference.
units.entry_condition: wedm-e2e-pipeline.test.ts exists with 17 tests (9 pass, 8 fail)
units.exit_condition: WEDM_SHAPE_MAP.md documents all 20 action shapes with frontend→engine translation notes

units.name: Feasibility bridge — translate flat params to nested FeasibilityInput
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_assess_feasibility': transform { features, material, thickness_mm, wire_diameter_mm, target_ra_um } into { features: [...mapped], material, workpiece: { thickness_mm, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm }, wire_diameter_mm }. Infer workpiece dimensions from features bounding box when not explicitly provided.
units.exit_condition: E2E Stage 3 (Feasibility) test passes. Frontend FeasibilityParams type works end-to-end.

units.name: Selection bridge — flatten FullSelectionResult to MaterialMachineWireSelection
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_full_selection': (1) transform frontend { material, features } into FullSelectionInput with part dimensions from features bounding box, (2) flatten FullSelectionResult { material_assessment, machine_selection, wire_selection, wire_diameter_optimization, controller_map } into { material, machine_id, machine_name, wire_type, wire_diameter_mm, controller, material_density_kg_m3 } matching MaterialMachineWireSelection type.
units.exit_condition: E2E Stage 4 (Selection) test passes. Frontend receives flat selection object.

units.name: Start holes bridge — convert features to ProfileGeometry[]
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_plan_start_holes': transform frontend { features } into engine-expected { profiles: ProfileGeometry[], workpiece: WorkpieceSpec }. Map PartFeature[] to ProfileGeometry[] using contour data. Flatten StartHolePlan { holes } to WCSResult { origin, start_holes, setup_notes }.

units.name: Toolpath bridge — convert frontend shape to ToolpathInput
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_generate_toolpath': transform frontend { features, contours, start_holes, material, wire_diameter_mm } into engine ToolpathInput { profiles: ProfileDefinition[], workpiece_thickness_mm, wire_diameter_mm }. Map contours to ProfileDefinition with contour_points, type classification (exterior/interior). Flatten result profiles_classified to ToolpathResult { profiles, tabs, sequence, total_cut_length_mm }.
units.exit_condition: E2E Stage 6 (Toolpath) test passes. Frontend receives ToolpathResult shape.

units.name: Multi-pass bridge — translate to MultiPassInput
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_full_multipass': transform frontend { material, wire_type, wire_diameter_mm, target_ra_um } into engine MultiPassInput { material, thickness_mm, profile_length_mm, tolerance_mm, target_ra_um, wire_diameter_mm, wire_type }. Provide sensible defaults for required fields (tolerance_mm=0.01, thickness_mm from prior step). Flatten MultiPassPlan to MultiPassResult { total_passes, passes, predicted_final_ra_um, predicted_recast_um, predicted_haz_um }.

sessions.name: Optimize + G-code + Cost/Setup Bridge + E2E Gate

units.name: Optimize bridge — CuttingParamFlush + wire break + flushing
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_optimize_params': transform frontend OptimizeParams into CuttingParamInput. Add required fields (pass_type defaults, base param lookup). Compose the optimize response from three engines: CuttingParamFlush.optimizeParams + planFlushing + predictWireBreakRisk → flatten into OptimizeResult { multipass, wire_break, flushing, estimated_time_min, predicted_pp }.

units.name: G-code bridge — translate to EDMGCodeInput with geometry
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts case 'wedm_generate_gcode': transform frontend ProgramStageParams { material, machine_id, controller, wire_type, wire_diameter_mm, profiles, multipass, flushing } into engine EDMGCodeInput with proper contour_points geometry. Flatten EDMGCodeResult to GCodeOutput { program, controller, line_count, estimated_run_time_min, warnings }. Test all 6 controller dialects.
units.exit_condition: E2E Stage 9 (G-code) tests pass for all 6 dialects.

units.name: Cost + Setup sheet bridge
units.description: In edmDispatcher.ts cases 'wedm_estimate_cost' and 'wedm_generate_setup_sheet': transform frontend ProgramStageParams into engine CostInput/SetupSheetInput with threading_time, tab_cutting, idle time defaults. Flatten CostEstimate to CostBreakdown { wire_cost_usd, machine_time_cost_usd, consumables_cost_usd, setup_cost_usd, total_cost_usd, wire_consumption_m, machine_time_min }. Flatten SetupSheet output.

units.name: Full chain E2E gate + frontend Quick Generate wiring
units.description: Run the full chain test (DXF → G-code). Fix any remaining issues. Wire the Quick Generate DAG in the frontend to populate WedmStudioContext with intermediate results. Add stale-data invalidation when user navigates backward. Final gate: all 17 E2E tests green, tsc 0 errors, 184+ WEDM tests pass.
units.exit_condition: wedm-e2e-pipeline.test.ts: 17/17 pass. tsc: 0 errors. wedm tests: 184+ pass.

criteria: All 184+ WEDM unit tests still pass (no regressions)
Frontend types match backend response shapes (no as-any casts)
Backward navigation invalidates stale step data
